movement_profile.footwork: Leaps, hops, side steps, and crossing feet
movement_profile.posture: W-position hands, facing center of the circle

signature_moves.description: Leap and hop on right, leap and hop on left, with left leg swaying.
signature_moves.name: Regular Toulama sequence

signature_moves.description: Side step right, cross left, jump on both, hop right with leg sway.
signature_moves.name: Two Legged Toulama sequence

music_profile.sound_description: The music is characterized by a high tempo and specific meter (2/4 or 6/8) that drives the repetitive, energetic movement of the circle dance.

teaching.level_notes: Intermediate: requires coordination of leaps, hops, and leg sways in a group setting.
